originalTitle: Trump orders US government to call AI ‘Super Intelligence’
summary: The US executive branch is no longer acknowledging the existence of "artificial intelligence." Going forward, official policy websites, policy documents, and press releases will refer only to "Super Intelligence," thanks to a new executive order signed by President Donald Trump. "The word super is the best word of all, and it's the simplest," Trump said […]
content: The US executive branch is no longer acknowledging the existence of “artificial intelligence.” Going forward, official policy websites, policy documents, and press releases will refer only to “Super Intelligence,” thanks to a new executive order signed by President Donald Trump. “The word super is the best word of all, and it’s the simplest,” Trump said at an event announcing the launch of America.gov earlier on Tuesday, and said Chinese President Xi Jinping, who visited the White House last week, “loves it” too. “We don’t want to hear artificial. Because it’s not artificial. It’s very powerful, it’s very brilliant. It’s going to mostly be put to good use and we’ll stop the bad use.” Artificial, he added, “is like the news. Fake news.” He first mentioned plans for the rebrand in a speech to the United Nations General Assembly last week, aiming to quell fears over AI advancing too quickly and posing a safety risk. Executive agencies won’t have to change past regulations or documents, but it could still constitute a real (and very strange) shift. Superintelligence is one of several industry terms for particularly powerful versions of artificial intelligence, but the Trump administration is seeking to use the term as a replacement for a broader statutory definition of AI. US officials will be expected not to even acknowledge the use of the terms “artificial intelligence” or “AI” in relevant settings.  Trump signed the executive order after a luncheon he hosted at the White House with tech CEOs and government officials to discuss what he’s now officially calling Super Intelligence. In brief public remarks after the meeting, flanked by Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang and Tesla and SpaceX CEO Elon Musk, and surrounded by other attendees, Trump called the lunch “very productive” and “extremely friendly.” “There’s a belief that there should be tremendous self-regulation,” Trump said. “And we automatically have regulation with the Department of Justice, the FBI, all of that.” On the local level, where tech companies have faced the most hurdles in building out massive data centers needed to run their services, Trump says the firms will “work to make the community happy” by providing resources and economic support they may need. Ultimately, he says, “data centers are going to be very popular.”
chineseTitle: 特朗普命令美国政府将 AI 称为“超级智能”
chineseSummary: 美国行政部门不再承认“人工智能”的存在。展望未来，由于唐纳德·特朗普总统签署了一项新的行政命令，官方政策网站、政策文件和新闻稿将仅提及“超级智能”。特朗普说：“‘超级’这个词是最好的词，也是最简单的。”
chineseContent: 美国行政部门不再承认“人工智能”的存在。展望未来，由于唐纳德·特朗普总统签署了一项新的行政命令，官方政策网站、政策文件和新闻稿将仅提及“超级智能”。周二早些时候，特朗普在宣布推出 America.gov 的活动中表示，“‘超级’这个词是最好的词，也是最简单的词。”他还表示，上周访问白宫的中国国家主席习近平也“喜欢这个词”。 “我们不想听到人造的。因为它不是人造的。它非常强大，非常出色。它大部分都会得到很好的利用，我们会停止不良的使用。”他补充道，人造的“就像新闻一样。假新闻。”他上周在联合国大会演讲时首次提到了品牌重塑计划，旨在平息人们对人工智能发展过快并带来安全风险的担忧。行政机构不必改变过去的法规或文件，但这仍然可能构成真正的（而且非常奇怪的）转变。超级智能是特别强大的人工智能版本的几个行业术语之一，但特朗普政府正在寻求使用该术语来替代更广泛的人工智能法定定义。预计美国官员甚至不会承认在相关环境中使用“人工智能”或“AI”一词。  特朗普在白宫与科技公司首席执行官和政府官员举行午餐会后签署了这项行政命令，讨论了他现在正式所说的“超级智能”。会后，特朗普在英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋、特斯拉和 SpaceX 首席执行官埃隆·马斯克以及其他与会者的簇拥下发表了简短的公开讲话，称这次午餐“非常富有成效”
whyItMatters: 这条信息属于 AI 与科技趋势信号，适合用于观察工具选型、产品机会、开发者关注点和技术路线变化。
